content: “Dule-machi, Seir-yarsik be atake, egi ibmar-guoed iduakwaa be soge.
Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob sogye, ega be soge:
” ’Ar be gusgu Israel-dulemar-e-isdarmaladsoggu, e-isgusad-ular, sabsur-odurdaklesad-ibagi, e-wilesad-ibagi, bemar egi bila onosad.

Degisoggu, ani an Bab-Jehová na dukin ise-sogar soged, burgwega an be-imakoed, burgwed begi banguosulid. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi soged: Ar be ablis-aryoed isdar-daksasulid, a-ulale, ablis-aryoed begi banguosulid.
Seir-yar nega-dulesulidganga an imakoed. Agi dule-danikoed, dule-ese-nadapoed an ogilogoed.
Muimar e-yarmar-ena an nasikoed. Dulemar-es-suidgi-burgwismalad be-yar-mullugangi, be-nebamargi, degi, be-diwarmargi ena omiledoed.
Degisadegu nega-dulesulidganga an be-imakoed, dulemar be-neggweburmargi bar bukuosulid. Geb degidbali, be wisguoed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue.’
”Seir, ar be sogsad: ‘Amba Bab-Jehová Israel-yargi-mai-inigwele, e-napaneg-sogbogwad, e-neggwebur-sogbogwad angadga guoed. Ani an e-ibedga guoed.’

A-ulale, ani an Bab-Jehová na dukin ise-sogar-soged, ar igi nobedba, isdar-dakedba, be Israel-dulemar-sabsur-imaksagusa, deyobi, an be-imakmogoed. Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged. Ar an sabsur-be-odurdaksale, bemar magar an-daknonimaloed.
Geb degine, be wisguoed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue. Be Israel-dulemargi urwedii gusad an bela itosad. Urwedgi be sogsagusad: ‘¡Bela oitolesmala, emigindi, anmar sunna obergue!’
Urwedgi, binsaed-satedgi be angi-sunmaksadi an be-itosad.
”Bab-Jehová-Bela-Gangued-Nikadi weyob soged: ‘Bela napneggi yeer-itomalaga, an be-obelogoed.

Ar igi Israel-dulemarga yar-uklesad-bergusgu, na be yeer-itosgusa, deyobi, an begi yeer-itomogoed. Be, Seir-yar, degi, bela Edom-yar, nega-dulesulidganga gumaloed. Degidbali, wisgumaloed, ani an Bab-Jehová gue.’ ”
